definitions.explanation: An uncomfortable sensation on the skin that makes one want to scratch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蚊|か}→蚊：04294_ka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刺|さ}されて→刺す：02111_sasu⟧かゆみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
examples.english: The itching from the mosquito bite is terrible.

examples.japanese: かゆみ{止|ど}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}った→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧かゆみ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悩|なや}んでいる→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧。
examples.english: I'm troubled by dry skin itchiness.

notes:
かゆみ is the noun form of the adjective ⟦かゆい→かゆい：02340_kayui⟧ (itchy). It refers to the itching sensation itself.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- かゆみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to develop itchiness
- かゆみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧: to suppress/relieve itchiness
- かゆみ{止|ど}め: anti-itch medication
- かゆみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧: the itching is severe

COMMON CAUSES:
- ⟦{虫刺|むしさ}され→虫刺され：22401_mushisasare⟧: insect bites
- ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧: dry skin
- ⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧: allergies
- ⟦{蕁麻疹|じんましん}→蕁麻疹：15182_jinmashin⟧: hives

FORMS:
Formed with the ～み suffix that converts adjectives to nouns describing the sensation: ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧ (pain), ⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧ (sadness), ⟦{温|あたた}かみ→温かみ：25336_atatakami⟧ (warmth).
